adjudication.rationale: Verified in lib/topic_retriever.rb: perform_retrieve calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, before falling back to `fetch_http`. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates `rss.items.each` importing each item via `TopicEmbed.import`, i.e., a full-feed import is performed synchronously in the context of a single embed_url retrieval. This is a real, diff-grounded performance/architecture concern (amplification), though not a deterministic correctness defect.
